data.name: RunIn: Encounters
data.detailed_description:
RunIn: Encounters is a competitive multiplayer fantasy combat game focused on skill-based PvP battles, tactical teamplay, and intense round-based encounters.

Fight in fast-paced online battles where timing, positioning, equipment choices, and teamwork determine victory. Adapt your build between rounds, master unique combat styles, and outplay your opponents in strategic melee and magic-based combat.

RunIn: Encounters delivers a modern competitive PvP experience inspired by classic fantasy combat systems.

KEY FEATURES

• Skill-Based PvP Combat
Engage in intense melee and magic-focused combat where player skill, timing, and tactical decisions matter.

• Round-Based Competitive Encounters
Adapt your equipment and strategy between rounds to counter enemy playstyles and dominate the battlefield.

• Team-Based Multiplayer Battles
Queue solo or fight alongside allies in competitive online encounters.

• Diverse Combat Builds
Experiment with different weapons, armor sets, abilities, and magical playstyles to create your own combat identity.

• Fantasy Combat Experience
Enter a fantasy world filled with steel, magic, and tactical warfare.

EARLY ACCESS

RunIn: Encounters is launching in Early Access to allow the community to actively participate in balancing, combat refinement, and future gameplay improvements throughout development.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 / AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains fantasy violence during competitive PvP combat involving swords, axes, bows, shields, and magic. Characters can be defeated in battle, and small blood stains may appear on the ground. There is no dismemberment, graphic injury, torture, or gore. Characters may also appear in non-sexual undergarments when no armor is equipped.
